Fire at Haldia Refinery Injures Several Workers

A significant fire erupted at the Haldia oil refinery in West Bengal, involving a naphtha-carrying pipeline. The blaze caused thick plumes of black smoke and resulted in burn injuries to several workers who were present in the vicinity. The exact cause of the fire is currently under investigation.
